brief:
The Netherlands expressed regret Monday over Israel's decision to revoke accreditation for Dutch diplomats in the West Bank, Al-Monitor reported. The move marks Israel's latest retaliation against Western pressure regarding settlement expansion in Palestinian territories.

Israel has escalated diplomatic responses to international criticism of its settlement policy, targeting countries that have voiced opposition to the expansion. The Dutch government's statement came as tensions between Israel and European nations over settlements intensified.
dek: The Netherlands said Monday it regretted Israel's decision to revoke accreditation of Dutch diplomats based in the West Bank, the latest retaliation by Israel to mounting Western pressure over settlements.
title: Netherlands condemns Israel's revocation of diplomat credentials over settlements
